# Wujood — Digital Presence Platform for Egyptian SMEs

> Website builder, WhatsApp CRM, social media tools, and AI chatbot for Egyptian SMEs. From 1,250 EGP/month. Arabic-first, Cairo-based.

## About
Wujood (وجود — "presence") helps Egyptian small businesses get found and trusted online. Every SME gets a mobile-friendly website, WhatsApp click-to-chat, social scheduling, and an Arabic/English AI assistant. Built for shops, restaurants, clinics, workshops across Egypt.
